title: Relocalization and Reference-Frame Tracking Implementation Plan
summary: 8-task implementation plan for BoW-based relocalization and reference-frame tracking to preserve maps during tracking loss.
notes: Implementation plan with task checklist for agentic workers. Contains embedded technical specifications and interfaces (API signatures, struct definitions) as part of task definitions, but the primary purpose and structure is execution guidance (step-by-step task breakdown). Actual technical specification is in the referenced spec document. Classified as DOC (runbook) rather than SPEC due to dominant task-execution-plan structure with checkbox tracking and goal-oriented task breakdown.
